ja.R: ソロモンは神に答えました。「あなたは、わたしの父ダビデに、とても深いいつくしみを示してくださいました。そして、父の代わりに、わたしを王にしてくださいました。

uk.L: І сказав Соломон Богові: «Ти виявив велику незмінну любов Давидові, моєму батькові, і зробив мене царем замість нього.
uk.B: Соломон сказав Богові: «Ти виявив велику незмінну любов моєму батькові Давидові, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} посадив мене на престол замість нього.
uk.R: Соломон відповів Богові: «Ти виявив велику вірну любов моєму батькові Давидові. І {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив мене царем замість нього.

decisions.choice: great steadfast love: loyal kindness that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word names love that is loyal to a bond and keeps its promises. Yahweh had promised David a son on his throne and a love that would not be taken away from him (1 Chronicles 17:11-13). Solomon sees that promise kept in himself.

decisions.choice: Solomon's prayer, shorter than in 1 Kings 3:6-7
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 3:6 has the same opening words, but there Solomon also calls David Yahweh's servant and speaks of how David walked before him in faithfulness and righteousness. Chronicles gives only the love shown to David and joins to it "you have made me king in his place" (compare 1 Kings 3:7). It also leaves out Solomon's words about being a little boy.

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this word in these books, as in 1 Kings 3:6.

decisions.choice: "amor leal" (L); "amor fiel" (B, R)
decisions.reason: *Ḥesed* follows the Psalms and Samuel notes, as in 1 Kings 3:6, whose opening words Chronicles repeats.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B); "rất nhân từ và thành tín" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the same words in 1 Kings 3:6, kept for *ḥesed* in this prayer (m1).

decisions.choice: Solomon prays in 합쇼체 with "주님" and "저"; "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R) for *ḥesed*
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 3:6, whose opening words this verse repeats.

decisions.choice: grande amor leal (every level)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 3:6 in Portuguese: God's steadfast love (m1) is "amor leal" at every level, where the English says "faithful love" at Balanced and Readable; it is the wording the refrain of 5:13 keeps too.

decisions.choice: Steadfast love (hesed) is "ጽኑ ፍቅር" at every level; Solomon prays with "አንተ"
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 3:6. Chronicles has no "your servant" before "David my father" here, so the Amharic has none.

decisions.choice: "अटल प्रेम" (every level)
decisions.reason: The LORD's hesed is अटल प्रेम at every level, as the history terms note sets and as in 1 Kings 3:6.

decisions.choice: "неизменная любовь" (L, B); "был очень добр и верен" (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD's hesed is "неизменная любовь", as in 1 Kings 3:6; Readable says it with a verb, as there.

decisions.choice: Solomon to God です・ます with light respect forms; chesed of God "誠実" (L), "いつくしみ" (B, R).
decisions.reason: As Solomon's prayer in 1 Kings 3:6 and the 1KI notes.

source.text: עַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵֽאָמֵן֙ דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔ עִ֖ם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַכְתַּ֔נִי עַל־עַ֕ם רַ֖ב כַּעֲפַ֥ר הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Now, Yahweh God, let be confirmed your word with David my father, for you have made me king over a people numerous like the dust of the earth.

en.L: Now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word to David my father be confirmed, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me king over a people as many as the dust of the earth.
en.B: Now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise to my father David prove true, since {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me king over a people as many as the dust of the earth.
en.R: Now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, please keep the promise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made to my father David. You have made me king over a people as countless as the dust of the earth.

es.L: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, que se confirme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra a David mi padre, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has hecho rey sobre un pueblo numeroso como el polvo de la tierra.
es.B: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, que se cumpla {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} promesa a mi padre David, ya que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has hecho rey sobre un pueblo tan numeroso como el polvo de la tierra.
es.R: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, te ruego que cumplas la promesa que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} le hiciste a mi padre David. Tú me has hecho rey sobre un pueblo tan numeroso como el polvo de la tierra.

fr.L: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole à David mon père soit confirmée, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as fait régner sur un peuple nombreux comme la poussière de la terre.
fr.B: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse à mon père David s’accomplisse, puisque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as fait roi d’un peuple aussi nombreux que la poussière de la terre.
fr.R: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, tiens la promesse que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faite à mon père David. Tu m’as fait roi d’un peuple aussi nombreux que la poussière de la terre.

sw.L: Sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwa Daudi baba yangu na lithibitishwe, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umenitawaza juu ya watu wengi kama mavumbi ya nchi.
sw.B: Sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa baba yangu Daudi na itimie, kwa kuwa umenifanya mfalme juu ya watu wengi kama mavumbi ya nchi.
sw.R: Sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, tafadhali timiza ahadi uliyompa baba yangu Daudi. Umenifanya mfalme juu ya watu wasiohesabika, wengi kama mavumbi ya nchi.

vi.L: Bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, nguyện lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [phán] với Đa-vít cha con được vững lập, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập con làm vua trên một dân đông như bụi đất.
vi.B: Bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, xin cho lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với Đa-vít cha con được thành tựu, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập con làm vua trên một dân đông như bụi đất.
vi.R: Bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với Đa-vít cha con. Ngài đã lập con làm vua trên một dân đông vô số như bụi trên mặt đất.

ko.L: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 제 아버지 다윗에게 하신 주님의 말씀이 굳게 서게 해 주십시오. 주님께서 땅의 먼지처럼 많은 백성 위에 저를 왕으로 삼으셨기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 제 아버지 다윗에게 하신 주님의 약속이 이루어지게 해 주십시오. 주님께서 저를 땅의 먼지처럼 많은 백성의 왕으로 세우셨기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 제 아버지 다윗에게 하신 약속을 지켜 주십시오. 주님께서 저를 땅의 먼지처럼 셀 수 없이 많은 백성의 왕으로 세우셨습니다.

pt.L: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, seja confirmada a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra a Davi, meu pai, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fizeste rei sobre um povo numeroso como o pó da terra.
pt.B: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, que se cumpra a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} promessa ao meu pai Davi, pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fizeste rei sobre um povo tão numeroso como o pó da terra.
pt.R: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, por favor, cumpre a promessa que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste ao meu pai Davi. Tu me fizeste rei sobre um povo que não se pode contar, como o pó da terra.

am.L: አሁንም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላክ ሆይ፣ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት [የተናገርኸው] ቃልህ ይጽና፤ እንደ ምድር አፈር በበዛ ሕዝብ ላይ አንተ አንግሠኸኛልና።
am.B: አሁንም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላክ ሆይ፣ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የገባኸው ተስፋ ይፈጸም፤ እንደ ምድር አፈር በበዛ ሕዝብ ላይ አንግሠኸኛልና።
am.R: አሁንም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላክ ሆይ፣ እባክህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የገባኸውን ተስፋ ፈጽም። እንደ ምድር አፈር ቁጥር በሌለው ሕዝብ ላይ አንግሠኸኛል።

hi.L: अब, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} परमेश्वर, मेरे पिता दाऊद से [कहा] तेरा वचन दृढ़ किया जाए, क्योंकि तूने मुझे ऐसी प्रजा पर राजा बनाया है जो पृथ्वी की धूल के समान बहुत है।
hi.B: अब, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} परमेश्वर, मेरे पिता दाऊद से की गई तेरी प्रतिज्ञा सच्ची ठहरे, क्योंकि तूने मुझे ऐसी प्रजा पर राजा बनाया है जो पृथ्वी की धूल के समान अनगिनत है।
hi.R: अब, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} परमेश्वर, कृपया वह प्रतिज्ञा पूरी कर जो तूने मेरे पिता दाऊद से की थी। तूने मुझे ऐसी प्रजा का राजा बनाया है जो पृथ्वी की धूल के कणों जितनी अनगिनत है।

ru.L: Теперь, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}} Боже, пусть исполнится {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} слово Давиду, моему отцу, потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} поставил меня царём над народом многочисленным, как прах земли.
ru.B: Теперь, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}} Боже, пусть сбудется {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} обещание моему отцу Давиду, ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} поставил меня царём над народом, многочисленным, как прах земли.
ru.R: Теперь, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}} Боже, исполни, пожалуйста, обещание, которое {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} дал моему отцу Давиду. Ты поставил меня царём над народом, которого так много, что его не сосчитать, как пыль на земле.

ja.L: 今、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}なる神よ、わたしの父ダビデへのあなたの言葉を確かなものとしてください。あなたが、地のちりのように多い民の上に、わたしを王とされたからです。
ja.B: 今、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}なる神よ、わたしの父ダビデへのあなたの約束を実現させてください。あなたは、地のちりのように多い民の王として、わたしを立ててくださったのですから。
ja.R: 今、神である{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、どうか、わたしの父ダビデにしてくださった約束を守ってください。あなたは、地のちりのように数えきれないほど多い民の王に、わたしをしてくださいました。

uk.L: Тепер, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}} Боже, нехай здійсниться {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово Давидові, моєму батькові, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив мене царем над народом, численним, як порох землі.
uk.B: Тепер, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}} Боже, нехай справдиться {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} обітниця моєму батькові Давидові, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив мене царем над народом, численним, як порох землі.
uk.R: Тепер, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}} Боже, прошу, дотримай обітниці, яку {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} дав моєму батькові Давидові. Ти зробив мене царем над народом, незліченним, як порох землі.

decisions.choice: let your word be confirmed: let your promise prove true
decisions.reason: The verb means to be made firm, shown to be true. "Your word" is Yahweh's promise to David that his son would reign and build the house (1 Chronicles 17:11-14). David prayed in the same words that the promise be confirmed (1 Chronicles 17:23-24); Solomon asks that it go on coming true in him.

decisions.choice: a people as many as the dust of the earth: the promise to Abraham
decisions.reason: Yahweh promised Abraham and Jacob descendants as many as the dust of the earth (Genesis 13:16; 28:14). 1 Kings 3:8 says instead "a great people, who cannot be numbered"; Chronicles uses the words of the promise itself.

decisions.choice: promise (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "word"; Balanced and Readable say "promise", which is what the word was (m1).

decisions.choice: please keep the promise
decisions.reason: Readable turns the wish "let it be confirmed" into a request to God, which is what it is.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on "tú", "tu"
decisions.reason: Solomon's words to God carry the deity_pronoun span on every written pronoun and possessive for God, as the Spanish Kings does; clitics ("te ruego") and sentence-initial "Tú" are written plain.

decisions.choice: "lời hứa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "lời" (word); Balanced and Readable say "lời hứa", which is what the word was (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "말씀" (L), "약속" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word God spoke to David is his promise (m1), as the English Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: SENHOR (vocative, no article)
decisions.reason: In the vocative the name has no article, "SENHOR Deus", as in Solomon's prayer in 1 Kings 3:7 in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДИ Боже" (vocative, every level)
decisions.reason: Both words of the address take the Russian vocative, as in 1 Kings 3:7; the divine_name setting has the vocative inside each option.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}なる神よ" (L, B), "神である{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ" (R) for YHWH Elohim in address.
decisions.reason: As David's prayer in 2 Samuel 7:25.

source.text: עַתָּ֗ה חָכְמָ֤ה וּמַדָּע֙ תֶּן־לִ֔י וְאֵֽצְאָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָֽעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה וְאָב֑וֹאָה כִּֽי־מִ֣י יִשְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת־עַמְּךָ֥ הַזֶּ֖ה הַגָּדֽוֹל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Now wisdom and knowledge give to me, and I will go out before this people and I will come in; for who will judge your people, this great [one]?

en.L: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out before this people and come in; for who can judge this great people of {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}?"
en.B: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may go out and come in before this people as their leader. For who can judge this great people of {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}?"
en.R: Give me wisdom and knowledge so that I can lead this people. Who could ever judge this great people of {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}?"

es.L: Ahora, dame sabiduría y conocimiento, para que salga y entre delante de este pueblo; porque ¿quién juzgará a este gran pueblo {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}?».
es.B: Ahora dame sabiduría y conocimiento, para que yo salga y entre delante de este pueblo como su jefe. Porque ¿quién es capaz de juzgar a este gran pueblo {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}?».
es.R: Dame sabiduría y conocimiento para que pueda guiar a este pueblo. ¿Quién podría juzgar a este gran pueblo {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}?».

fr.L: Maintenant, donne-moi sagesse et connaissance, pour que je sorte devant ce peuple et que j’entre ; car qui jugera {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, ce [peuple] si grand ? »
fr.B: Maintenant, donne-moi la sagesse et la connaissance, afin que je sache sortir et entrer devant ce peuple pour le conduire. Car qui pourrait juger un peuple aussi grand que le {{deity_pronoun:tien|Tien}} ? »
fr.R: Donne-moi la sagesse et la connaissance, pour que je puisse diriger ce peuple. Qui pourrait juger un peuple aussi grand que le {{deity_pronoun:tien|Tien}} ? »

sw.L: Sasa nipe hekima na maarifa, nipate kutoka na kuingia mbele ya watu hawa; kwa maana ni nani awezaye kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hawa walio wengi?"
sw.B: Sasa nipe hekima na maarifa, ili nipate kutoka na kuingia mbele ya watu hawa kama kiongozi wao. Kwa maana ni nani awezaye kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walio wengi namna hii?"
sw.R: Nipe hekima na maarifa ili niweze kuwaongoza watu hawa. Ni nani angeweza kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walio wengi hivi?"

vi.L: Bây giờ xin ban cho con sự khôn ngoan và sự hiểu biết, để con đi ra đi vào trước dân này; vì ai có thể xét xử dân lớn này của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"
vi.B: Bây giờ xin ban cho con sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết, để con đi ra đi vào trước dân này mà lãnh đạo họ. Vì ai có thể xét xử dân đông đảo này của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"
vi.R: Xin ban cho con sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết để con biết lãnh đạo dân này. Ai có thể xét xử một dân đông như dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"

ko.L: 이제 제게 지혜와 지식을 주셔서, 제가 이 백성 앞에서 나가고 들어오게 해 주십시오. 누가 주님의 이 큰 백성을 재판할 수 있겠습니까?"
ko.B: 이제 제게 지혜와 지식을 주셔서, 이 백성 앞에서 나가고 들어오며 그들을 이끌 수 있게 해 주십시오. 누가 이렇게 많은 주님의 백성을 재판할 수 있겠습니까?"
ko.R: 저에게 지혜와 지식을 주셔서 이 백성을 이끌 수 있게 해 주십시오. 누가 이렇게 많은 주님의 백성을 다스릴 수 있겠습니까?"

pt.L: Agora dá-me sabedoria e conhecimento, para que eu saia diante deste povo e entre; pois quem julgará este {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo tão grande?"
pt.B: Agora dá-me sabedoria e conhecimento, para que eu possa sair e entrar à frente deste povo como o seu líder. Pois quem é capaz de julgar este grande povo, que é {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}}?"
pt.R: Dá-me sabedoria e conhecimento para que eu saiba liderar este povo. Quem conseguiria julgar este povo tão grande, que é {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}}?"

am.L: አሁንም በዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት እወጣና እገባ ዘንድ ጥበብንና እውቀትን ስጠኝ፤ ይህን ታላቅ ሕዝብህን ሊፈርድ የሚችል ማን ነውና?»
am.B: አሁንም እንደ መሪ በዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት እንድወጣና እንድገባ ጥበብንና እውቀትን ስጠኝ። ይህን የሚያህል ታላቅ ሕዝብህን ሊፈርድ የሚችል ማን ነው?»
am.R: ይህን ሕዝብ መምራት እንድችል ጥበብንና እውቀትን ስጠኝ። ይህን ያህል ታላቅ ሕዝብህን ሊፈርድ የሚችል ማን ነው?»

hi.L: अब मुझे बुद्धि और ज्ञान दे, कि मैं इस प्रजा के सामने बाहर जाऊँ और भीतर आऊँ; क्योंकि तेरी इस बड़ी प्रजा का न्याय कौन कर सकता है?"
hi.B: अब मुझे बुद्धि और ज्ञान दे, ताकि मैं इस प्रजा के अगुवे के रूप में उसके सामने बाहर जाऊँ और भीतर आऊँ। क्योंकि तेरी इस बड़ी प्रजा का न्याय कौन कर सकता है?"
hi.R: मुझे बुद्धि और ज्ञान दे, ताकि मैं इस प्रजा की अगुवाई कर सकूँ। भला तेरी इस बड़ी प्रजा का न्याय कौन कर सकता है?"

ru.L: Теперь дай мне мудрость и знание, чтобы я выходил перед этим народом и входил; ведь кто может судить этот {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} великий народ?»
ru.B: Дай же мне мудрость и знание, чтобы я мог выходить и входить перед этим народом, как подобает правителю. Ведь кто может судить этот великий {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ?»
ru.R: Дай мне мудрость и знание, чтобы я мог править этим народом. Разве может кто-нибудь судить такой великий {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} народ?»

ja.L: 今、わたしに知恵と知識を与えてください。そうすれば、わたしはこの民の前に出て行き、また入って来ます。だれが、このあなたの大いなる民を裁くことができるでしょうか？」
ja.B: 今、わたしに知恵と知識を与えてください。そうすれば、わたしはこの民の前に出入りして、彼らを導くことができます。だれが、これほど大きなあなたの民を裁くことができるでしょうか？」
ja.R: どうか、わたしに知恵と知識を与えてください。そうすれば、この民を導くことができます。これほど大勢のあなたの民を、いったいだれが裁くことができるでしょうか？」

uk.L: Тепер дай мені мудрість і знання, щоб я виходив перед цим народом і входив; бо хто може судити цей {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} великий народ?»
uk.B: Тепер дай мені мудрість і знання, щоб я міг виходити й входити перед цим народом як його провідник. Бо хто може судити цей {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} великий народ?»
uk.R: Дай мені мудрість і знання, щоб я міг провадити цей народ. Хто ж зміг би судити цей {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} великий народ?»

decisions.choice: wisdom and knowledge: Solomon's request in other words than 1 Kings 3:9
decisions.reason: In 1 Kings 3:9 Solomon asks for "a listening heart to judge your people, to discern between good and evil". Here he asks for "wisdom and knowledge", and the phrase "to go out and come in", which in Kings belongs to his confession that he does not know how (1 Kings 3:7), becomes the purpose of his request. The closing question is much the same, but Kings calls the people "heavy" and Chronicles "great".

decisions.choice: knowledge: understanding, insight
decisions.reason: The word is a rare one, found also in Daniel 1:4, 17 and Ecclesiastes 10:20. It means knowledge or understanding, the ability to grasp what is going on and see what should be done. With "wisdom" it names the skill a ruler needs.

decisions.choice: go out and come in before this people: lead them
decisions.reason: To go out and come in before a people is to lead them in war and in peace, in all their affairs (Numbers 27:17; 1 Samuel 18:16; 1 Chronicles 11:2).

decisions.choice: judge: govern and settle disputes
decisions.reason: The king's judging includes ruling the people and deciding their cases with justice (1 Kings 3:9, 28).

decisions.choice: go out and come in ... as their leader (Balanced); lead (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 3:7: Balanced keeps the picture and adds what it means; Readable says only what it means (m3).

decisions.choice: "salga y entre ... como su jefe" (B); "guiar" (R)
decisions.reason: To go out and come in before a people is to lead them (meaning decision); Balanced adds "como su jefe", as the Spanish of 1 Kings 3:7, and Readable says "guiar".

decisions.choice: maarifa
decisions.reason: The rare word for knowledge (m2) is "maarifa"; "ufahamu" is kept for "understanding" in the 1 Kings 3 parallel, and Chronicles uses another word.

decisions.choice: "đi ra đi vào ... mà lãnh đạo họ" (B); "lãnh đạo" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 3:7: Balanced keeps the picture and adds what it means; Readable says only what it means (m3).

decisions.choice: "나가고 들어오며 그들을 이끌" (B); "이끌" (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom means to lead the people (m3), as the English Balanced and Readable make clear.

decisions.choice: sabedoria e conhecimento; sair e entrar à frente deste povo como o seu líder (B); liderar (R)
decisions.reason: "Sabedoria e conhecimento" for the pair Solomon asks for (m1, m2), the same two words through verses 11-12. The idiom (m3) keeps the words of 1 Kings 3:7 in Portuguese: Balanced keeps the picture and adds what it means, Readable says "liderar".

decisions.choice: The closing question keeps 1 Kings 3:9 ("… ሕዝብህን ሊፈርድ የሚችል ማን ነው?"), with "ታላቅ" (great) for the Kings "ከባድ" (heavy) at Literal
decisions.reason: Chronicles has gadol, "great", where Kings has kaved, "heavy"; Balanced and Readable already said "great" in Kings. The request itself, "wisdom and knowledge", differs from the "listening heart" of Kings and is translated afresh.

decisions.choice: "выходить и входить" (L, B); "править" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 3:7: Balanced keeps the picture and adds "как подобает правителю"; Readable says only what it means (m3).

decisions.choice: "出入りして、彼らを導く" (B), "導く" (R) for going out and coming in before the people.
alternatives: "出ることも入ることも" (L only)
decisions.reason: The idiom means leading them, as the meaning decision says.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר־אֱלֹהִ֣ים׀לִשְׁלֹמֹ֡ה יַ֣עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה זֹ֜את עִם־לְבָבֶ֗ךָ וְלֹֽא־שָׁ֠אַלְתָּ עֹ֣שֶׁר נְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ וְאֵת֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאֶ֔יךָ וְגַם־יָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לֹ֣א שָׁאָ֑לְתָּ וַתִּֽשְׁאַל־לְךָ֙ חָכְמָ֣ה וּמַדָּ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁפּוֹט֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלַכְתִּ֖יךָ עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And said God to Solomon, Because that was this with your heart, and not you asked wealth, riches and honor, and [the] life of those hating you, and also days many not you asked, and you asked for yourself wisdom and knowledge that you may judge my people over which I have made you king,

en.L: And God said to Solomon, "Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked for wealth, riches and honor, or the life of those who hate you, and also have not asked for many days, but have asked for yourself wisdom and knowledge so that you may judge {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people over whom I have made you king,
en.B: God said to Solomon, "Because this was what your heart desired, and you have not asked for wealth, riches or honor, or the death of those who hate you, or even for a long life, but have asked for wisdom and knowledge so that you can judge {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people over whom I have made you king,
en.R: So God said to Solomon, "This is what you truly wanted. You did not ask to be rich or wealthy or honored. You did not ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to kill those who hate you. You did not even ask to live a long time. Instead, you asked for wisdom and knowledge so that you can judge {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, the people I have made you king over.

es.L: Y dijo Dios a Salomón: «Porque esto estuvo en tu corazón, y no pediste riquezas, bienes ni gloria, ni la vida de los que te aborrecen, y tampoco pediste muchos días, sino que pediste para ti sabiduría y conocimiento para juzgar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, sobre el cual te he hecho rey,
es.B: Dios le dijo a Salomón: «Porque esto era lo que deseaba tu corazón, y no pediste riquezas, bienes ni gloria, ni la muerte de los que te odian, ni siquiera una larga vida, sino que pediste sabiduría y conocimiento para juzgar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, sobre el cual te he hecho rey,
es.R: Entonces Dios le dijo a Salomón: «Esto es lo que de verdad querías. No pediste ser rico ni tener muchos bienes ni ser honrado. No me pediste que matara a los que te odian. Ni siquiera pediste vivir mucho tiempo. En cambio, pediste sabiduría y conocimiento para juzgar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, el pueblo sobre el cual te he hecho rey.

fr.L: Et Dieu dit à Salomon : « Parce que c’est cela qui était dans ton cœur, et que tu n’as pas demandé la richesse, les biens et la gloire, ni la vie de ceux qui te haïssent, et que tu n’as pas non plus demandé de nombreux jours, mais que tu as demandé pour toi la sagesse et la connaissance afin de juger {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple sur lequel je t’ai fait régner,
fr.B: Dieu dit à Salomon : « Puisque c’est là ce que ton cœur désirait, et que tu n’as demandé ni la richesse, ni les biens, ni la gloire, ni la mort de ceux qui te haïssent, ni même une longue vie, mais que tu as demandé la sagesse et la connaissance pour pouvoir juger {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, dont je t’ai fait roi,
fr.R: Alors Dieu a dit à Salomon : « Voilà ce que tu désirais vraiment. Tu n’as pas demandé d’être riche, d’avoir des biens ou d’être honoré. Tu ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as pas demandé de faire mourir ceux qui te haïssent. Tu n’as même pas demandé de vivre longtemps. Au contraire, tu as demandé la sagesse et la connaissance pour pouvoir juger {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, le peuple dont je t’ai fait roi.

sw.L: Mungu akamwambia Sulemani, "Kwa sababu jambo hili lilikuwa moyoni mwako, wala hukuomba mali, utajiri na heshima, wala roho za wale wanaokuchukia, wala hukuomba siku nyingi, bali umejiombea hekima na maarifa ili upate kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ambao nimekutawaza juu yao,
sw.B: Mungu akamwambia Sulemani, "Kwa kuwa hili ndilo moyo wako ulilolitamani, wala hukuomba mali, utajiri au heshima, wala kifo cha wale wanaokuchukia, wala hata maisha marefu, bali umeomba hekima na maarifa ili uweze kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ambao nimekufanya mfalme juu yao,
sw.R: Basi Mungu akamwambia Sulemani, "Hili ndilo ulilolitaka kweli. Hukuomba kuwa tajiri wala kuwa na mali wala kuheshimiwa. Hukuniomba niwaue wale wanaokuchukia. Hukuomba hata kuishi muda mrefu. Badala yake, umeomba hekima na maarifa ili uweze kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, watu ambao nimekufanya mfalme juu yao.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời phán với Sa-lô-môn: "Vì điều này đã ở trong lòng ngươi, và ngươi đã không xin của cải, giàu có và vinh hiển, hay mạng sống của những kẻ ghét ngươi, và cũng không xin sống lâu, nhưng đã xin cho mình sự khôn ngoan và sự hiểu biết để ngươi xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập ngươi làm vua cai trị,
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời phán với Sa-lô-môn: "Vì đó là điều lòng con mong muốn, và con đã không xin của cải, giàu sang hay vinh hiển, cũng không xin mạng sống của những kẻ ghét con, thậm chí không xin được sống lâu, nhưng đã xin sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết để có thể xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là dân mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập con làm vua cai trị,
vi.R: Vậy Đức Chúa Trời phán với Sa-lô-môn: "Đây là điều con thật lòng mong muốn. Con đã không xin được giàu có, sung túc hay được tôn trọng. Con đã không xin {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giết những kẻ ghét con. Con cũng không xin được sống lâu. Trái lại, con đã xin sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết để có thể xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là dân mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập con làm vua cai trị.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님께서 솔로몬에게 말씀하셨다. "이것이 네 마음에 있어서, 네가 재물과 부와 영예와 너를 미워하는 자들의 목숨을 구하지 않았고, 또 많은 날도 구하지 않았으며, 내가 너를 왕으로 삼은 내 백성을 재판하려고 너를 위하여 지혜와 지식을 구했으므로,
ko.B: 하나님께서 솔로몬에게 말씀하셨다. "네 마음의 소원이 이것이어서, 재물이나 부나 영예나 너를 미워하는 자들의 죽음을 구하지 않고, 오래 살기도 구하지 않고, 오직 내가 너를 왕으로 세운 내 백성을 재판할 수 있도록 지혜와 지식을 구했으므로,
ko.R: 그러자 하나님께서 솔로몬에게 말씀하셨다. "이것이 네가 정말로 바라던 것이구나. 너는 부자가 되게 해 달라고 하지 않았다. 영예를 달라고 하지도 않았다. 너를 미워하는 자들을 죽여 달라고 하지도 않았다. 오래 살게 해 달라고 하지도 않았다. 그 대신에 너는 지혜와 지식을 구해서, 내가 너를 왕으로 세운 내 백성을 재판하려고 했다.

pt.L: E Deus disse a Salomão: "Porque isto estava no teu coração, e não pediste riqueza, bens e honra, nem a vida dos que te odeiam, e também não pediste muitos dias, mas pediste para ti sabedoria e conhecimento para julgares o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, sobre o qual eu te fiz rei,
pt.B: Deus disse a Salomão: "Porque era isso que o teu coração desejava, e não pediste riquezas, bens ou honra, nem a morte dos que te odeiam, nem mesmo uma vida longa, mas pediste sabedoria e conhecimento para poderes julgar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, sobre o qual eu te fiz rei,
pt.R: Então Deus disse a Salomão: "Isto é o que tu querias de verdade. Tu não pediste para ser rico, nem para ter muitos bens, nem para receber honras. Não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pediste para matar os que te odeiam. Nem mesmo pediste para viver muito tempo. Em vez disso, pediste sabedoria e conhecimento para poderes julgar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, o povo sobre o qual eu te fiz rei.

am.L: እግዚአብሔርም ሰሎሞንን እንዲህ አለው፦ «ይህ በልብህ ስለ ነበረ፣ ባለጠግነትንና ሀብትን ክብርንም የሚጠሉህንም ሰዎች ነፍስ ስላልለመንክ፣ ደግሞም ብዙ ዘመንን ስላልለመንክ፣ ነገር ግን በእርሱ ላይ ያነገሥኩህን ሕዝቤን ትፈርድ ዘንድ ጥበብንና እውቀትን ለራስህ ስለ ለመንክ፣

decisions.choice: this was in your heart: this was what you truly wanted
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the heart is the seat of thought and will. To say that something was "with your heart" means that it was what Solomon really wished for and intended (compare 1 Chronicles 22:7; 28:2).

decisions.choice: God's answer, worded differently from 1 Kings 3:11
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 3:11 lists what Solomon did not ask in another order: long life, wealth, the life of his enemies. Chronicles puts wealth first, adds "riches" and "honor", says "those who hate you" for "your enemies", and puts long life last. Instead of "discernment to hear justice" it repeats "wisdom and knowledge", and it adds that Yahweh made Solomon king over his people.

decisions.choice: the life of those who hate you: their death
decisions.reason: To ask for someone's life is to ask that he be put to death (as in 1 Kings 3:11). The things Solomon did not ask for are the usual wishes of kings: riches, honor, victory over their foes and long life.

decisions.choice: wealth, riches: two words for possessions
decisions.reason: The first word is the usual word for wealth; the second, found also in Joshua 22:8 and Ecclesiastes 5:18; 6:2, means possessions or goods. Together they say "great riches".

decisions.choice: Because ... , (the sentence continues in verse 12)
decisions.reason: God's sentence runs into the next verse, where its main clause comes. Literal and Balanced end this verse with a comma; Readable makes short sentences of its own.

decisions.choice: ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to kill those who hate you
decisions.reason: Readable says what asking for the life of enemies means (m3).

decisions.choice: "riquezas, bienes ni gloria" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Two words for possessions and one for honor (meaning decision); "gloria" for *kavod* follows the Spanish of 1 Kings 3:13, and Readable says "ser honrado".

decisions.choice: "la richesse, les biens et la gloire"
decisions.reason: Two words for possessions are kept apart as "richesse" and "biens"; "gloire" is the word French Kings uses for the same honor (1 Kings 3:13).

decisions.choice: mali, utajiri (Literal, Balanced); kuwa tajiri wala kuwa na mali (Readable)
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words for possessions (m4) are "mali" and "utajiri", so that Swahili keeps two words as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "của cải, giàu có" (L); "của cải, giàu sang" (B); "giàu có, sung túc" (R)
decisions.reason: Two Hebrew words for possessions (m4); Vietnamese keeps two words so that the list stays as long as the Hebrew's.

decisions.choice: The sentence runs on into verse 12 with "...구했으므로,"
alternatives: closing verse 11 as its own sentence
decisions.reason: As the English Literal and Balanced; Readable closes each clause.

decisions.choice: riqueza(s), bens
decisions.reason: The two words for possessions (m4) are "riqueza" and "bens", the second the ordinary Portuguese word for goods and property; "honra" as in 1 Kings 3:13 in Portuguese. Verse 12 repeats the three.

decisions.choice: "ባለጠግነት" (wealth), "ሀብት" (riches), "ክብር" (honor)
decisions.reason: Chronicles names three goods where 1 Kings 3:11 has one; "ባለጠግነት" is the Kings word for the first, and "ሀብት" keeps the second distinct.

decisions.choice: "души ненавидящих тебя" (L); "смерти ненавидящих тебя" (B)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 3:11: Literal keeps the Hebrew "life" (nefesh) as "души"; Balanced says what asking for it means (m3).

decisions.choice: verse ends with a dash, the sentence continuing in verse 12
decisions.reason: God's sentence runs on into verse 12, where its main clause comes; Russian marks the break with a dash where the English has a comma.

decisions.choice: The sentence runs on with "…ので、" into verse 12, as the English.
decisions.reason: Keeps the Hebrew's because-clause across the verse boundary.

hi.B: बुद्धि और ज्ञान तुम्हें दिया गया है। मैं तुम्हें धन, संपत्ति और सम्मान भी दूँगा, इतना कि न तुमसे पहले किसी राजा के पास था, न तुम्हारे बाद किसी के पास होगा।"
hi.R: इसलिए मैं तुम्हें बुद्धि और ज्ञान दे रहा हूँ। मैं तुम्हें संपत्ति, धन और सम्मान भी दूँगा। तुमसे पहले किसी राजा के पास इतना नहीं था, और तुम्हारे बाद किसी राजा के पास इतना नहीं होगा।"

ru.L: мудрость и знание даны тебе; и богатство, и имущество, и славу {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам тебе, каких не было у царей, которые [были] прежде тебя, и после тебя не будет такого.»
ru.B: мудрость и знание даны тебе. И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам тебе богатство, имущество и славу, каких не было ни у одного царя до тебя и не будет ни у кого после тебя.»
ru.R: Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} даю тебе мудрость и знание. И ещё {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам тебе богатство, имущество и славу. Ни у одного царя до тебя не было столько, и ни у одного царя после тебя столько не будет.»

ja.L: 知恵と知識はあなたに与えられている。そして富と財産と誉れも、わたしはあなたに与える。あなたより前にいた王たちにはそのようなことはなく、あなたの後にも、そのようなことはない。」
ja.B: 知恵と知識はあなたに与えられる。わたしはまた、富と財産と誉れも、あなたに与える。それは、あなたより前のどの王も持たなかったほどのもので、あなたの後にも、だれも持つことはない。」
ja.R: だから、あなたに知恵と知識を与えよう。それに、富も財産も誉れも与えよう。あなたより前の王で、これほど多くを持った者はいなかった。あなたの後の王も、これほど多くを持つことはない。」

uk.L: мудрість і знання дано тобі; а статки, і багатство, і славу Я дам тобі, яких не мали царі, що [були] перед тобою, і після тебе не матиме ніхто такого.»
uk.B: мудрість і знання дано тобі. Я дам тобі також статки, багатство й славу, яких не мав жоден цар перед тобою і не матиме жоден після тебе.»
uk.R: Тож Я даю тобі мудрість і знання. Я дам тобі також багатство, статки й славу. Жоден цар перед тобою не мав стільки, і жоден цар після тебе не матиме стільки.»

decisions.choice: given to you: already granted
decisions.reason: The word is a passive form, "given", that describes a settled fact. God grants the request as he speaks.

decisions.choice: none like you: 1 Kings 3:12-14 in other words
decisions.reason: In 1 Kings 3:12-13 God gives Solomon "a wise and discerning heart", says none before or after will be like him, and then adds wealth and honor. Chronicles says "wisdom and knowledge", and applies the comparison with kings before and after to the wealth and honor. It leaves out the promise of long life on condition of obedience (1 Kings 3:14).

decisions.choice: wealth, riches and honor: given freely
decisions.reason: Because Solomon did not ask for them, God gives them too. Verses 14-17 begin to show that this came true.

decisions.choice: the wisdom ... (lower case, continuing verse 11)
decisions.reason: This verse completes the sentence that began in verse 11, so Literal and Balanced continue it without a capital letter.

decisions.choice: No king before you ever had so much, and no king after you will have as much.
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the comparison into a sentence of its own.

records.literal_gloss: And came Solomon to the high place that [was] at Gibeon, [to] Jerusalem, from before [the] tent of meeting, and he reigned over Israel.

en.L: And Solomon came [from] the high place that [was] at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tent of meeting, and he reigned over Israel.
en.B: Then Solomon left the tent of meeting at the high place in Gibeon and came back to Jerusalem, and he reigned over Israel.
en.R: Then Solomon left the meeting tent at the hilltop shrine in Gibeon and went back to Jerusalem. And he ruled as king over Israel.

es.L: Y vino Salomón [desde] el lugar alto que [estaba] en Gabaón a Jerusalén, de delante de la Tienda del Encuentro, y reinó sobre Israel.
es.B: Después Salomón dejó la Tienda del Encuentro, en el lugar alto de Gabaón, y volvió a Jerusalén, y reinó sobre Israel.
es.R: Después Salomón dejó la Tienda del Encuentro, en el santuario sobre la colina de Gabaón, y volvió a Jerusalén. Y gobernó como rey sobre Israel.

fr.L: Et Salomon revint [du] haut lieu qui [était] à Gabaon à Jérusalem, de devant la tente de la Rencontre, et il régna sur Israël.
fr.B: Puis Salomon quitta la tente de la Rencontre, au haut lieu de Gabaon, et revint à Jérusalem ; et il régna sur Israël.
fr.R: Ensuite, Salomon a quitté la tente de la Rencontre, au sanctuaire sur la colline de Gabaon, et il est retourné à Jérusalem. Et il a régné sur Israël.

sw.L: Sulemani akaja [kutoka] mahali pa juu palipokuwa Gibeoni mpaka Yerusalemu, kutoka mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, akatawala juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Kisha Sulemani aliondoka kwenye Hema la Kukutania mahali pa juu huko Gibeoni, akarudi Yerusalemu, akatawala juu ya Israeli.
sw.R: Kisha Sulemani aliondoka kwenye Hema la Kukutania katika patakatifu pa kilimani huko Gibeoni, akarudi Yerusalemu. Akatawala kama mfalme juu ya Israeli.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn đi [từ] nơi cao [ở] tại Ga-ba-ôn về Giê-ru-sa-lem, từ trước Lều Hội Kiến, và vua trị vì trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Rồi Sa-lô-môn rời Lều Hội Kiến tại nơi cao ở Ga-ba-ôn mà trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem, và vua trị vì trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Rồi Sa-lô-môn rời Lều Hội Kiến tại nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao ở Ga-ba-ôn và trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua cai trị trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 기브온에 있는 산당[에서], 회막 앞에서 떠나 예루살렘으로 와서, 이스라엘을 다스렸다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 솔로몬은 기브온 산당에 있는 회막을 떠나 예루살렘으로 돌아와서 이스라엘을 다스렸다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 솔로몬은 기브온의 산꼭대기 제단에 있던 회막을 떠나 예루살렘으로 돌아갔다. 그리고 왕으로서 이스라엘을 다스렸다.

pt.L: E Salomão veio [do] alto que [estava] em Gibeom a Jerusalém, de diante da tenda do encontro, e reinou sobre Israel.
pt.B: Então Salomão deixou a tenda do encontro, no alto de Gibeom, e voltou para Jerusalém. E reinou sobre Israel.
pt.R: Então Salomão deixou a tenda do encontro, no santuário no alto do morro em Gibeom, e voltou para Jerusalém. E governou como rei sobre Israel.

hi.B: तब सुलैमान गिबोन के ऊँचे स्थान पर के मिलन के तंबू से लौटकर यरूशलेम आया, और उसने इस्राएल पर राज्य किया।
hi.R: तब सुलैमान गिबोन के ऊँचे स्थान पर के मिलन के तंबू से चलकर यरूशलेम लौट आया। और वह इस्राएल पर राजा होकर राज्य करने लगा।

ru.L: И пришёл Соломон [с] высоты, которая [была] в Гаваоне, в Иерусалим, от шатра встречи, и царствовал над Израилем.
ru.B: Затем Соломон ушёл от шатра встречи, из святилища на холме в Гаваоне, и вернулся в Иерусалим, и царствовал над Израилем.
ru.R: Потом Соломон ушёл от шатра встречи из святилища на холме в Гаваоне и вернулся в Иерусалим. И он стал править Израилем как царь.

ja.L: そしてソロモンは、ギブオンにある高き所[から]、会見の天幕の前から、エルサレムに来た。そして彼はイスラエルを治めた。
ja.B: それからソロモンは、ギブオンの高き所にある会見の天幕の前を去って、エルサレムに帰り、イスラエルを治めた。
ja.R: それからソロモンは、ギブオンの丘の上の礼拝所にある、神と会うテントを離れて、エルサレムに帰りました。そして、王としてイスラエルを治めました。

uk.L: І прийшов Соломон [з] пагірка, що [був] у Гаваоні, до Єрусалиму, від намету зустрічі, і царював над Ізраїлем.
uk.B: Потім Соломон залишив намет зустрічі на узвишші в Гаваоні й повернувся до Єрусалиму, і він царював над Ізраїлем.
uk.R: Потім Соломон залишив намет зустрічі на узвишші в Гаваоні й повернувся до Єрусалиму. І він правив як цар над Ізраїлем.

decisions.choice: from the high place
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "to the high place", which does not fit a journey from Gibeon to Jerusalem "from before the tent of meeting". The ancient Greek and Latin translations read "from", and the sense must be that, either because a letter was miscopied or because "came" here means "came back from [going] to". The meaning is not in doubt: Solomon returned from Gibeon.

decisions.choice: the return to Jerusalem: 1 Kings 3:15 told briefly
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 3:15 says that Solomon woke from the dream, came to Jerusalem, stood before the ark, made offerings and held a feast; then comes the case of the two women (3:16-28). Chronicles tells only the return and goes straight on to Solomon's wealth (verses 14-17), which shows God's promise of verse 12 coming true.

decisions.choice: and he reigned over Israel: the reign begins in earnest
decisions.reason: The clause sums up what follows: from Gibeon Solomon returns to rule, with the gift he asked for.

decisions.choice: left the tent of meeting at the high place in Gibeon and came back to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the places in the order of the journey; the Hebrew names the high place, then Jerusalem, then the tent.

source.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֣ף שְׁלֹמֹה֮ רֶ֣כֶב וּפָרָשִׁים֒ וַֽיְהִי־ל֗וֹ אֶ֤לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּנִּיחֵם֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְעִם־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And gathered Solomon chariotry and horsemen, and was to him a thousand and four hundred chariot[s] and two [and] ten thousand horsemen, and he stationed them in [the] cities of the chariotry and with the king in Jerusalem.

en.L: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen; and he had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, and he stationed them in the cities of the chariots and with the king in Jerusalem.
en.B: Solomon built up a force of chariots and horsemen. He had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, which he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
en.R: Solomon built up a large force of chariots and horsemen. He had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen. He kept some of them in the cities where his chariots were based, and some with him in Jerusalem.

es.L: Y juntó Salomón carros y jinetes; y tenía 1 400 carros y 12 000 jinetes, y los puso en las ciudades de los carros y con el rey en Jerusalén.
es.B: Salomón reunió un ejército de carros y jinetes. Tenía 1 400 carros y 12 000 jinetes, que estacionó en las ciudades de los carros y con el rey en Jerusalén.
es.R: Salomón reunió un gran ejército de carros de guerra y jinetes. Tenía 1 400 carros y 12 000 jinetes. A algunos los tenía en las ciudades donde estaban sus carros, y a otros con él en Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et Salomon rassembla des chars et des cavaliers ; et il eut 1 400 chars et 12 000 cavaliers, et il les plaça dans les villes des chars et auprès du roi à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Salomon constitua une force de chars et de cavaliers. Il eut 1 400 chars et 12 000 cavaliers, qu’il installa dans les villes de garnison des chars et auprès du roi à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Salomon a rassemblé une grande armée de chars et de cavaliers. Il avait 1 400 chars et 12 000 cavaliers. Il en a gardé une partie dans les villes où étaient basés ses chars, et une partie avec lui à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Sulemani akakusanya magari ya vita na wapanda farasi; alikuwa na magari ya vita 1,400 na wapanda farasi 12,000, akawaweka katika miji ya magari ya vita na pamoja na mfalme huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Sulemani aliunda jeshi la magari ya vita na wapanda farasi. Alikuwa na magari ya vita 1,400 na wapanda farasi 12,000, aliowaweka katika miji ya magari ya vita na pamoja na mfalme huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Sulemani aliunda jeshi kubwa la magari ya vita na wapanda farasi. Alikuwa na magari ya vita 1,400 na wapanda farasi 12,000. Aliweka baadhi yao katika miji yalimokaa magari yake ya vita, na wengine pamoja naye huko Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn tập hợp xe chiến mã và kỵ binh; vua có 1.400 xe chiến mã và 12.000 kỵ binh, và vua đóng họ trong các thành để xe chiến mã và ở với vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn xây dựng một lực lượng xe chiến mã và kỵ binh. Vua có 1.400 xe chiến mã và 12.000 kỵ binh, đóng tại các thành để xe chiến mã và ở với vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn xây dựng một lực lượng lớn gồm xe chiến mã và kỵ binh. Vua có 1.400 xe chiến mã và 12.000 kỵ binh. Vua để một số ở các thành đóng quân xe chiến mã, và một số ở với vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 병거와 기병을 모았는데, 그에게는 병거 1,400대와 기병 1만 2천 명이 있었다. 그는 그들을 병거 성읍들과 예루살렘 왕의 곁에 두었다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 병거와 기병을 모았다. 그에게는 병거가 1,400대, 기병이 1만 2천 명 있었는데, 그는 그들을 병거 성읍들과 예루살렘 왕의 곁에 두었다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 병거와 기병을 많이 모았다. 그에게는 병거 1,400대와 기병 1만 2천 명이 있었다. 그는 그들 가운데 일부는 병거를 두는 성읍들에, 일부는 예루살렘에 자기 곁에 두었다.

pt.L: E Salomão ajuntou carros e cavaleiros; e ele tinha mil e quatrocentos carros e doze mil cavaleiros, e ele os alojou nas cidades dos carros e com o rei em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Salomão formou uma força de carros de guerra e cavaleiros. Tinha mil e quatrocentos carros e doze mil cavaleiros, que ele mantinha nas cidades dos carros e com o rei em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Salomão formou uma grande força de carros de guerra e cavaleiros. Ele tinha mil e quatrocentos carros e doze mil cavaleiros. Deixou uma parte deles nas cidades onde ficavam os seus carros, e outra parte com ele em Jerusalém.

am.L: ሰሎሞንም ሰረገሎችንና ፈረሰኞችን ሰበሰበ፤ 1,400 ሰረገሎችና 12,000 ፈረሰኞችም ነበሩት፤ በሰረገሎች ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም ከንጉሡ ጋር አኖራቸው።
am.B: ሰሎሞን የሰረገሎችንና የፈረሰኞችን ሠራዊት አደራጀ። 1,400 ሰረገሎችና 12,000 ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት፤ እነርሱንም በሰረገሎች ከተሞችና ከንጉሡ ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራቸው።
am.R: ሰሎሞን የሰረገሎችንና የፈረሰኞችን ታላቅ ሠራዊት አደራጀ። 1,400 ሰረገሎችና 12,000 ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት። ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹን ሰረገሎቹ በሚቀመጡባቸው ከተሞች፣ አንዳንዶቹን ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራቸው።

hi.L: और सुलैमान ने रथ और घुड़सवार इकट्ठे किए; और उसके 1,400 रथ और 12,000 घुड़सवार थे, और उसने उन्हें रथों के नगरों में और यरूशलेम में राजा के पास रखा।
hi.B: सुलैमान ने रथों और घुड़सवारों की सेना खड़ी की। उसके पास 1,400 रथ और 12,000 घुड़सवार थे, जिन्हें उसने रथों के नगरों में और यरूशलेम में राजा के पास रखा।
hi.R: सुलैमान ने रथों और घुड़सवारों की एक बड़ी सेना खड़ी की। उसके पास 1,400 रथ और 12,000 घुड़सवार थे। उनमें से कुछ को उसने उन नगरों में रखा जहाँ उसके रथ रहते थे, और कुछ को अपने साथ यरूशलेम में।

ru.L: И собрал Соломон колесницы и всадников; и было у него тысяча четыреста колесниц и двенадцать тысяч всадников, и он разместил их в городах колесниц и при царе в Иерусалиме.
ru.B: Соломон собрал колесницы и всадников. У него было 1400 колесниц и 12 000 всадников, которых он разместил в городах для колесниц и при себе, царе, в Иерусалиме.
ru.R: Соломон собрал большое войско из колесниц и всадников. У него было 1400 колесниц и 12 000 всадников. Одних он держал в городах, где стояли его колесницы, а других — при себе в Иерусалиме.

ja.L: そしてソロモンは戦車と騎兵を集め、彼には千四百台の戦車と一万二千の騎兵があった。彼はそれらを戦車の町々と、エルサレムの王のもとに配置した。
ja.B: ソロモンは戦車と騎兵を増強した。彼には戦車が千四百台、騎兵が一万二千あり、それらを戦車隊の町々と、エルサレムの王のもとに配置した。
ja.R: ソロモンは、たくさんの戦車と騎兵をそろえました。戦車は千四百台、騎兵は一万二千人いました。ソロモンは、その一部を戦車を置く町々に、一部をエルサレムの自分のそばに置きました。

uk.L: І зібрав Соломон колісниці й вершників; і було в нього тисяча чотириста колісниць і дванадцять тисяч вершників, і він розмістив їх у містах колісниць і з царем в Єрусалимі.
uk.B: Соломон зібрав військо колісниць і вершників. У нього було тисяча чотириста колісниць і дванадцять тисяч вершників, і він розмістив їх у містах для колісниць і при цареві в Єрусалимі.
uk.R: Соломон зібрав велике військо колісниць і вершників. У нього було тисяча чотириста колісниць і дванадцять тисяч вершників. Частину він тримав у містах, де стояли його колісниці, а частину при собі в Єрусалимі.

decisions.choice: Solomon's chariots: the same words as 1 Kings 10:26
decisions.reason: Verses 14-17 repeat, almost word for word, 1 Kings 10:26-29, where they come near the end of Solomon's story; 2 Chronicles 9:25-28 has a similar summary. Placed here, right after the promise of verse 12, they show at once the wealth and honor God gave.

decisions.choice: horsemen: the men who rode or drove, or perhaps the horses themselves
decisions.reason: The word usually means horsemen, but it can also mean horses for chariots (as in 1 Kings 10:26; 5:6).

decisions.choice: the chariot cities: towns with stables and barracks for the chariot force
decisions.reason: Solomon built towns for his chariots and horsemen (8:6; 1 Kings 9:19).

decisions.choice: some ... and some with him
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 10:26: Readable says that the force was divided, and "with him" for "with the king".

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Kings 10:26 kept
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats 1 Kings 10:26 almost word for word (meaning decision), so the Spanish Kings wording is kept at each level.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 10:26, unchanged; numbers in figures
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 1 Kings 10:26 (m1), so the Vietnamese of that verse is kept at each level. Numbers above a thousand are written in figures with a dot, as in Kings.

decisions.choice: The wording of 1 Kings 10:26 at each level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of verses 14-17 is that of 1 Kings 10:26-29, so the Korean repeats that passage, changing only what the Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 10:26
decisions.reason: Verses 14-17 repeat 1 Kings 10:26-29 (m1), and the Portuguese of 1 Kings is kept at every level. The numbers are round, so they are written in words, as there, where the English uses figures.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 1 Kings 10:26 at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of the two verses is the same (apart from one spelling), so the parallels rule keeps one wording.

decisions.choice: Worded as the parallel 1 Kings 10:26 at every level.
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as in Kings.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־הַכֶּ֧סֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָ֛ב בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם כָּאֲבָנִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת הָאֲרָזִ֗ים נָתַ֛ן כַּשִּׁקְמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה לָרֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And made the king the silver and the gold in Jerusalem like stones, and the cedars he made like the sycamores which [are] in the Shephelah, for abundance.

en.L: And the king made the silver and the gold in Jerusalem like stones, and the cedars he made like the sycamores that [are] in the Shephelah, for abundance.
en.B: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedar as plentiful as the sycamore-fig trees of the Shephelah.
en.R: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones. Cedar wood became as plentiful as the fig trees that grow in the western foothills.

es.L: E hizo el rey que en Jerusalén la plata y el oro fueran como piedras, y los cedros los hizo como los sicómoros que [hay] en la Sefela, en abundancia.
es.B: El rey hizo que en Jerusalén la plata y el oro fueran tan comunes como las piedras, y el cedro tan abundante como los sicómoros de la Sefela.
es.R: El rey hizo que en Jerusalén la plata y el oro fueran tan comunes como las piedras. La madera de cedro llegó a ser tan abundante como las higueras que crecen en las colinas del oeste.

fr.L: Et le roi rendit l’argent et l’or à Jérusalem [aussi communs] que les pierres, et il rendit les cèdres [aussi nombreux] que les sycomores qui [sont] dans la Shéfela, en abondance.
fr.B: Le roi rendit l’argent et l’or aussi communs à Jérusalem que les pierres, et le cèdre aussi abondant que les sycomores de la Shéfela.
fr.R: Le roi a rendu l’argent et l’or aussi courants à Jérusalem que les pierres. Le bois de cèdre est devenu aussi abondant que les figuiers qui poussent dans les collines de l’ouest.

sw.L: Mfalme akaifanya fedha na dhahabu katika Yerusalemu kuwa kama mawe, na mierezi akaifanya kuwa kama mikuyu iliyo katika Shefela, kwa wingi.
sw.B: Mfalme aliifanya fedha na dhahabu kuwa vya kawaida huko Yerusalemu kama mawe, na mierezi akaifanya kuwa mingi kama mikuyu ya Shefela.
sw.R: Mfalme aliifanya fedha na dhahabu kuwa vya kawaida huko Yerusalemu kama mawe. Mbao za mierezi zikawa nyingi kama mikuyu inayoota katika vilima vya magharibi.

vi.L: Vua làm cho bạc và vàng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem như đá, và gỗ bá hương vua làm cho như cây sung ở vùng Sơ-phê-la, vì rất nhiều.
vi.B: Vua làm cho bạc và vàng ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nhiều như đá, và gỗ bá hương nhiều như cây sung ở vùng Sơ-phê-la.
vi.R: Vua làm cho bạc và vàng ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nhiều như đá. Gỗ bá hương cũng nhiều như cây sung mọc ở vùng đồi phía tây.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 예루살렘에서 은과 금을 돌처럼 [흔하게] 만들었고, 백향목을 세펠라에 있는 돌무화과나무처럼 많게 했다.
ko.B: 왕 덕분에 예루살렘에서는 은과 금이 돌처럼 흔해졌고, 백향목은 세펠라의 돌무화과나무처럼 많아졌다.
ko.R: 왕 덕분에 예루살렘에서는 은과 금이 돌처럼 흔해졌다. 백향목도 서쪽 낮은 산지에서 자라는 무화과나무처럼 많아졌다.

pt.L: E o rei fez a prata e o ouro em Jerusalém como as pedras, e os cedros ele fez como os sicômoros que [estão] na Sefelá, em abundância.
pt.B: O rei tornou a prata e o ouro tão comuns em Jerusalém como as pedras, e o cedro tão abundante como os sicômoros das colinas da Sefelá.
pt.R: O rei fez a prata e o ouro ficarem tão comuns em Jerusalém como as pedras. A madeira de cedro ficou tão abundante como as figueiras que crescem nas colinas do oeste.

am.L: ንጉሡም በኢየሩሳሌም ብሩንና ወርቁን እንደ ድንጋይ አደረጋቸው፤ ዝግባውንም ከብዛቱ የተነሣ በሽፌላ እንዳሉት ሾላዎች አደረገው።
am.B: ንጉሡ በኢየሩሳሌም ብርንና ወርቅን እንደ ድንጋይ የተለመደ አደረጋቸው፤ ዝግባውንም በቆላማው አገር እንዳሉት ሾላዎች የበዛ አደረገው።
am.R: ንጉሡ በኢየሩሳሌም ብርንና ወርቅን እንደ ድንጋይ የተለመደ አደረጋቸው። የዝግባ እንጨትም በምዕራብ ባሉት ዝቅተኛ ኮረብቶች እንደሚበቅሉት የሾላ ዛፎች በዛ።

hi.L: और राजा ने यरूशलेम में चाँदी और सोने को पत्थरों के समान, और देवदारों को शफेला के गूलरों के समान, बहुतायत से कर दिया।
hi.B: राजा ने यरूशलेम में चाँदी और सोने को पत्थरों जैसा आम कर दिया, और देवदार को पश्चिम की तराई के गूलर के पेड़ों जैसा बहुतायत से।
hi.R: राजा ने यरूशलेम में चाँदी और सोने को पत्थरों जैसा आम कर दिया। देवदार की लकड़ी पश्चिम की नीची पहाड़ियों में उगनेवाले गूलर के पेड़ों जितनी बहुतायत से मिलने लगी।

ru.L: И сделал царь серебро и золото в Иерусалиме подобными камням, а кедры сделал подобными сикоморам, которые в Шефеле, по множеству.
ru.B: Царь сделал серебро и золото в Иерусалиме такими же обычными, как камни, а кедров стало так же много, как сикомор в Шефеле.
ru.R: Царь сделал так, что серебра и золота в Иерусалиме было столько же, сколько камней. А кедрового дерева стало так же много, как смоковниц, что растут в западных предгорьях.

ja.L: そして王は、エルサレムで銀と金を石のようにし、杉をシェフェラにあるいちじく桑の木のように豊かにした。
ja.B: 王は、エルサレムで銀と金を石ころのようにありふれたものとし、杉の木をシェフェラのいちじく桑の木のように豊富にした。
ja.R: 王の時代、エルサレムでは、銀や金が石ころのようにありふれたものになりました。杉の木も、西の丘陵地帯に生えているいちじくの木のように、たくさんありました。

uk.L: І зробив цар срібло й золото в Єрусалимі, як каміння, а кедри зробив, як сикомори, що [ростуть] у Шефелі, щодо численності.
uk.B: Цар зробив срібло й золото в Єрусалимі таким звичайним, як каміння, а кедрів — так багато, як сикомор у Шефелі.
uk.R: Цар зробив срібло й золото в Єрусалимі таким звичайним, як каміння. Кедрового дерева стало так багато, як фігових дерев, що ростуть у західних передгірʼях.

decisions.choice: silver and gold: Chronicles adds the gold
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 10:27 and 2 Chronicles 9:27 say only that the king made silver like stones. This verse adds "and the gold"; the rest is the same.

decisions.choice: like stones, like the sycamores: a deliberate overstatement
decisions.reason: Stones lay everywhere in the hills of Judah. The verse says, with poetic exaggeration, that silver, gold and costly cedar from Lebanon became as common as the most ordinary things in the land.

decisions.choice: the sycamores in the Shephelah: common fig trees of the low hills
decisions.reason: The sycamore fig bears small figs and gives cheap, ordinary timber (Isaiah 9:9; Amos 7:14). The Shephelah is the region of low hills between the coastal plain and the hill country of Judah.

decisions.choice: sycamore-fig trees of the Shephelah (Balanced); fig trees that grow in the western foothills (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 10:27: the English "sycamore" names a different tree, and Readable explains the Shephelah by where it lies.

decisions.choice: "los sicómoros de la Sefela" (B); "las higueras que crecen en las colinas del oeste" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 10:27 in Spanish, with "y el oro", which Chronicles adds (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "bạc và vàng"; otherwise 1 Kings 10:27
decisions.reason: Chronicles adds the gold (m1); the rest keeps the Vietnamese of 1 Kings 10:27, "cây sung" for the sycamore-fig and "vùng đồi phía tây" for the Shephelah at Readable.

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 10:27, with "e o ouro"
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 10:27 in Portuguese at every level ("sicômoros", "as colinas da Sefelá", Readable's "colinas do oeste"), adding only the gold that Chronicles adds (m1).

decisions.choice: 1 Kings 10:27 with "and the gold" added ("ብሩንና ወርቁን … አደረጋቸው")
decisions.reason: Chronicles adds the gold to the silver; otherwise the Hebrew is the same as Kings, and so is the Amharic.

decisions.choice: "сикоморы" (L, B), "смоковницы" (R); "Шефела" (L, B), "западные предгорья" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 10:27, with the gold that Chronicles adds.

decisions.choice: As 1 Kings 10:27 with "金" added where Chronicles adds the gold.
decisions.reason: Keeps the parallel wording where the Hebrew is the same.

source.text: וּמוֹצָ֧א הַסּוּסִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וּמִקְוֵ֕א סֹחֲרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ מִקְוֵ֥א יִקְח֖וּ בִּמְחִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] export of the horses which [were] to Solomon [was] from Egypt and from Kue; [the] traders of the king from Kue would take [them] at [a] price.

en.L: And the export of the horses that [were] Solomon's [was] from Egypt and from Kue; the traders of the king would take [them] from Kue at a price.
en.B: Solomon's horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue; the king's traders bought them from Kue at the going price.
en.R: Solomon's horses were brought in from Egypt and from Kue. The king's traders bought them in Kue and paid for them.

es.L: Y los caballos de Salomón [se traían] de Egipto y de Cue; los mercaderes del rey [los] compraban en Cue por un precio.
es.B: Los caballos de Salomón se importaban de Egipto y de Cue; los mercaderes del rey los compraban en Cue al precio corriente.
es.R: Los caballos de Salomón se traían de Egipto y de Cue. Los mercaderes del rey los compraban en Cue y los pagaban.

fr.L: Et la sortie des chevaux qui [étaient] à Salomon [était] d’Égypte et de Qoué ; les marchands du roi les prenaient à Qoué contre paiement.
fr.B: Les chevaux de Salomon venaient d’Égypte et de Qoué ; les marchands du roi les achetaient à Qoué au prix courant.
fr.R: Les chevaux de Salomon venaient d’Égypte et de Qoué. Les marchands du roi les achetaient à Qoué et les payaient.

sw.L: Na uletaji wa farasi waliokuwa wa Sulemani [ulikuwa] kutoka Misri na kutoka Kue; wafanyabiashara wa mfalme waliwanunua kutoka Kue kwa bei.
sw.B: Farasi wa Sulemani waliletwa kutoka Misri na kutoka Kue; wafanyabiashara wa mfalme waliwanunua kutoka Kue kwa bei ya soko.
sw.R: Farasi wa Sulemani waliletwa kutoka Misri na kutoka Kue. Wafanyabiashara wa mfalme waliwanunua huko Kue na kuwalipia.

vi.L: Ngựa của Sa-lô-môn được nhập từ Ai Cập và từ Cu-ê; các thương gia của vua mua [chúng] từ Cu-ê theo giá.
vi.B: Ngựa của Sa-lô-môn được nhập từ Ai Cập và từ Cu-ê; các thương gia của vua mua chúng tại Cu-ê theo giá thị trường.
vi.R: Ngựa của Sa-lô-môn được đem về từ Ai Cập và từ Cu-ê. Các thương gia của vua mua chúng tại Cu-ê và trả tiền đàng hoàng.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬의 말들은 이집트와 구에에서 들여왔는데, 왕의 상인들이 값을 치르고 구에에서 [그것들을] 사 왔다.
ko.B: 솔로몬의 말들은 이집트와 구에에서 들여왔다. 왕의 상인들이 구에에서 시세대로 값을 치르고 사 왔다.
ko.R: 솔로몬의 말들은 이집트와 구에에서 들여왔다. 왕의 상인들이 구에에서 값을 치르고 그 말들을 사 왔다.

pt.L: E a saída dos cavalos que [eram] de Salomão [era] do Egito e de Cue; os negociantes do rei [os] tomavam de Cue por um preço.
pt.B: Os cavalos de Salomão eram importados do Egito e de Cue; os negociantes do rei os compravam em Cue pelo preço corrente.
pt.R: Os cavalos de Salomão vinham do Egito e de Cue. Os negociantes do rei os compravam em Cue e pagavam por eles.

am.L: የሰሎሞንም የፈረሶቹ መውጫ ከግብፅና ከቀዌ ነበረ፤ የንጉሡም ነጋዴዎች ከቀዌ በዋጋ ይወስዷቸው ነበር።
am.B: ሰሎሞን ፈረሶቹን ያስመጣ የነበረው ከግብፅና ከቀዌ ነበር፤ የንጉሡ ነጋዴዎች በወቅቱ ዋጋ ከቀዌ ይገዟቸው ነበር።
am.R: የሰሎሞን ፈረሶች የሚመጡት ከግብፅና ከቀዌ ነበር። የንጉሡ ነጋዴዎች በቀዌ ገዝተው ዋጋቸውን ይከፍሉ ነበር።

hi.L: और सुलैमान के घोड़े मिस्र से और कूए से आते थे; राजा के व्यापारी उन्हें दाम देकर कूए से लेते थे।
hi.B: सुलैमान के घोड़े मिस्र से और कूए से मँगाए जाते थे; राजा के व्यापारी उन्हें चलते दाम पर कूए से ख़रीदते थे।
hi.R: सुलैमान के घोड़े मिस्र और कूए से लाए जाते थे। राजा के व्यापारी उन्हें कूए में ख़रीदकर दाम चुकाते थे।

ru.L: А вывоз коней, которые [были] у Соломона, — из Египта и из Кувы; купцы царя брали [их] из Кувы за плату.
ru.B: Коней для Соломона привозили из Египта и из Кувы; царские купцы покупали их в Куве по обычной цене.
ru.R: Коней для Соломона привозили из Египта и из Кувы. Царские купцы покупали их в Куве и платили за них.

ja.L: そしてソロモンの馬の輸入はエジプトとクエからであった。王の商人たちは、クエから代価を払って[それらを]受け取った。
ja.B: ソロモンの馬は、エジプトとクエから輸入されていた。王の商人たちは、相場の値段でクエから買い入れた。
ja.R: ソロモンの馬は、エジプトとクエから連れて来られました。王の商人たちは、クエで代金を払って、馬を買いました。

uk.L: А вивезення коней, що [були] в Соломона, [було] з Єгипту і з Кує; царські купці брали [їх] з Кує за ціну.
uk.B: Соломонових коней привозили з Єгипту і з Кує; царські купці купували їх у Кує за звичайною ціною.
uk.R: Соломонових коней привозили з Єгипту і з Кує. Царські купці купували їх у Кує й платили за них.

decisions.choice: the horse trade: the same words as 1 Kings 10:28
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 1 Kings 10:28; only the spelling of Kue differs slightly.

decisions.choice: Kue: a land in the south of present-day Turkey
decisions.reason: Kue is known from other ancient records as a land later called Cilicia, famous for its horses. The Hebrew vowels make the name look like a word for "a gathering", and older translations read it as "in droves" or "linen yarn" (see 1 Kings 10:28). The place name fits the trade route of verses 16-17.

decisions.choice: horses from Egypt: what the law warned a king against
decisions.reason: The law of the king told him not to gather many horses or send the people back to Egypt to get them (Deuteronomy 17:16), nor to gather much silver and gold (17:17). Here, as in Kings, the horses and gold are listed without comment.

decisions.choice: imported (Balanced); brought in (Readable); bought ... at the going price
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 10:28: the Hebrew "export" looks at the horses leaving their land; Balanced and Readable look at them arriving in Israel.

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 10:28; Cue
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 1 Kings 10:28 (m1), and so does the Portuguese at every level, with the land's ancient name in the form "Cue" (m2).

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 1 Kings 10:28 at every level, Kue "ቀዌ"
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells Kue with a different final letter and orders the last clause a little differently, with the same sense; the wording stays that of Kings.

records.literal_gloss: And they brought up and brought out from Egypt [a] chariot for six hundred silver, and [a] horse for fifty and hundred; and thus for all [the] kings of the Hittites and [the] kings of Aram, by their hand they would bring [them] out.

en.L: And they brought up and brought out from Egypt a chariot for 600 [shekels of] silver, and a horse for 150; and so for all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram, by their hand they would bring [them] out.
en.B: They would import a chariot from Egypt for {{units:about 15 pounds|600 shekels}} of silver, and a horse for {{units:about 3 3/4 pounds|150 shekels}}. In the same way they exported them, through the king's traders, to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.
en.R: A chariot from Egypt cost {{units:about 15 pounds|600 shekels}} of silver, and a horse cost {{units:about 3 3/4 pounds|150 shekels}}. The king's traders also sold horses and chariots to all the kings of the Hittites and of Aram.

es.L: Y subían y sacaban de Egipto un carro por seiscientos [siclos de] plata, y un caballo por ciento cincuenta; y así, por medio de ellos, [los] sacaban para todos los reyes de los hititas y para los reyes de Aram.
es.B: Un carro se importaba de Egipto por {{units:unos 7 kilos|seiscientos siclos}} de plata, y un caballo por {{units:1,7 kilos|ciento cincuenta siclos}}. De la misma manera, por medio de los mercaderes del rey, los exportaban a todos los reyes de los hititas y a los reyes de Aram.
es.R: Un carro de Egipto costaba {{units:unos 7 kilos|seiscientos siclos}} de plata, y un caballo {{units:1,7 kilos|ciento cincuenta siclos}}. Los mercaderes del rey también vendían caballos y carros a todos los reyes de los hititas y de Aram.

fr.L: Et ils faisaient monter et sortir d’Égypte un char pour six cents [sicles] d’argent, et un cheval pour cent cinquante ; et ainsi, pour tous les rois des Hittites et les rois d’Aram, ils les faisaient sortir par leur main.
fr.B: On importait d’Égypte un char pour {{units:environ 7 kilos|600 sicles}} d’argent, et un cheval pour {{units:environ 1,7 kilo|150 sicles}}. De la même façon, par l’intermédiaire des marchands du roi, on les exportait vers tous les rois des Hittites et les rois d’Aram.
fr.R: Un char venu d’Égypte coûtait {{units:environ 7 kilos|600 sicles}} d’argent, et un cheval {{units:environ 1,7 kilo|150 sicles}}. Les marchands du roi vendaient aussi des chevaux et des chars à tous les rois des Hittites et d’Aram.

sw.L: Wakapandisha na kutoa kutoka Misri gari la vita kwa [shekeli] 600 za fedha, na farasi kwa 150; na vivyo hivyo kwa wafalme wote wa Wahiti na wafalme wa Aramu, kwa mkono wao waliwatoa.
sw.B: Gari la vita lingeweza kuletwa kutoka Misri kwa {{units:karibu kilo 6.9|shekeli 600}} za fedha, na farasi kwa {{units:karibu kilo 1.7|shekeli 150}}. Vivyo hivyo, kupitia wafanyabiashara wa mfalme, waliwauzia wafalme wote wa Wahiti na wafalme wa Aramu.
sw.R: Gari la vita kutoka Misri liligharimu {{units:karibu kilo 6.9|shekeli 600}} za fedha, na farasi {{units:karibu kilo 1.7|shekeli 150}}. Wafanyabiashara wa mfalme waliwauzia pia farasi na magari ya vita wafalme wote wa Wahiti na wa Aramu.

vi.L: Họ đem lên và xuất từ Ai Cập một cỗ xe với giá 600 [siếc-lơ] bạc, và một con ngựa 150; cũng vậy, họ xuất chúng qua tay mình cho tất cả các vua người Hê-tít và các vua A-ram.
vi.B: Một cỗ xe nhập từ Ai Cập giá {{units:khoảng 6,9 kg|600 siếc-lơ}} bạc, và một con ngựa {{units:khoảng 1,7 kg|150 siếc-lơ}}. Cũng vậy, qua các thương gia của vua, họ xuất khẩu chúng cho tất cả các vua người Hê-tít và các vua A-ram.
vi.R: Một cỗ xe từ Ai Cập giá {{units:khoảng 6,9 kg|600 siếc-lơ}} bạc, và một con ngựa giá {{units:khoảng 1,7 kg|150 siếc-lơ}}. Các thương gia của vua cũng bán ngựa và xe cho tất cả các vua người Hê-tít và các vua A-ram.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 이집트에서 병거를 은 600 [세겔에], 말을 150 [세겔에] 들여와 내보냈다. 이와 같이 헷 사람의 모든 왕과 아람의 왕들에게도 그들의 손으로 [그것들을] 내다 팔았다.
ko.B: 그들은 병거 한 대를 이집트에서 은 {{units:약 6.9킬로그램|600세겔}}에, 말 한 마리를 {{units:약 1.7킬로그램|150세겔}}에 들여왔다. 왕의 상인들은 또 이것들을 헷 사람의 모든 왕과 아람 왕들에게 내다 팔았다.
ko.R: 이집트에서 들여오는 병거 한 대 값은 은 {{units:약 6.9킬로그램|600세겔}}이었고, 말 한 마리 값은 {{units:약 1.7킬로그램|150세겔}}이었다. 왕의 상인들은 말과 병거를 헷 사람의 모든 왕과 아람 왕들에게도 팔았다.

pt.L: E faziam subir e sair do Egito um carro por seiscentos [siclos de] prata, e um cavalo por cento e cinquenta; e assim, para todos os reis dos hititas e para os reis de Arã, pela mão deles [os] faziam sair.
pt.B: Eles importavam do Egito um carro por {{units:cerca de 7 quilos|seiscentos siclos}} de prata, e um cavalo por {{units:cerca de 1,7 quilo|cento e cinquenta siclos}}. Do mesmo modo, por meio dos negociantes do rei, eles os exportavam para todos os reis dos hititas e para os reis de Arã.
pt.R: Um carro do Egito custava {{units:cerca de 7 quilos|seiscentos siclos}} de prata, e um cavalo custava {{units:cerca de 1,7 quilo|cento e cinquenta siclos}}. Os negociantes do rei também vendiam cavalos e carros a todos os reis dos hititas e de Arã.

am.L: ከግብፅም ሰረገላን በ600 [ሰቅል] ብር፣ ፈረስንም በ150 ያወጡና ያመጡ ነበር፤ እንዲሁም ለኬጢያውያን ነገሥታት ሁሉና ለአራም ነገሥታት በእጃቸው ያወጡ ነበር።
am.B: አንድ ሰረገላ ከግብፅ በ{{units:6.9 ኪሎ ያህል|600 ሰቅል}} ብር፣ አንድ ፈረስም በ{{units:1.7 ኪሎ ያህል|150 ሰቅል}} ብር ያስመጡ ነበር። እንዲሁም በንጉሡ ነጋዴዎች በኩል ለኬጢያውያን ነገሥታት ሁሉና ለአራም ነገሥታት ይሸጡ ነበር።
am.R: ከግብፅ የሚመጣ አንድ ሰረገላ {{units:6.9 ኪሎ ያህል|600 ሰቅል}} ብር፣ አንድ ፈረስ ደግሞ {{units:1.7 ኪሎ ያህል|150 ሰቅል}} ብር ያወጣ ነበር። የንጉሡ ነጋዴዎች ለኬጢያውያን ነገሥታት ሁሉና ለአራም ነገሥታትም ፈረሶችንና ሰረገሎችን ይሸጡ ነበር።

hi.L: और वे मिस्र से एक रथ छह सौ [शेकेल] चाँदी में, और एक घोड़ा डेढ़ सौ में, चढ़ाकर बाहर ले आते थे; और इसी प्रकार हित्तियों के सब राजाओं के लिए और अराम के राजाओं के लिए वे उनके हाथ से [उन्हें] बाहर ले जाते थे।
hi.B: मिस्र से एक रथ {{units:लगभग 7 किलो|600 शेकेल}} चाँदी में, और एक घोड़ा {{units:लगभग 1.7 किलो|150 शेकेल}} चाँदी में मँगाया जा सकता था। इसी प्रकार वे राजा के व्यापारियों के द्वारा उन्हें हित्तियों के सब राजाओं और अराम के राजाओं के पास भी भेजते थे।
hi.R: मिस्र से आनेवाले एक रथ का दाम {{units:लगभग 7 किलो|600 शेकेल}} चाँदी था, और एक घोड़े का {{units:लगभग 1.7 किलो|150 शेकेल}}। राजा के व्यापारी हित्तियों के सब राजाओं और अराम के राजाओं को भी घोड़े और रथ बेचते थे।

ru.L: И поднимали и вывозили из Египта колесницу за шестьсот [сиклей] серебра, а коня — за сто пятьдесят; и так всем царям хеттов и царям Арама через них вывозили [их].
ru.B: Колесницу привозили из Египта за {{units:около 7 килограммов|600 сиклей}} серебра, а коня — за {{units:около 1,7 килограмма|150 сиклей}}. Так же через царских купцов их вывозили ко всем царям хеттов и к царям Арама.
ru.R: Колесница из Египта стоила {{units:около 7 килограммов|600 сиклей}} серебра, а конь — {{units:около 1,7 килограмма|150 сиклей}}. Царские купцы продавали коней и колесницы также всем царям хеттов и царям Арама.

ja.L: そして彼らは、戦車をエジプトから銀六百[シェケル]で上らせて輸入し、馬を百五十で[輸入した]。そのように、ヘト人のすべての王たちとアラムの王たちに、彼らの手によって[それらを]輸出した。
ja.B: 戦車はエジプトから銀{{units:約7キログラム|六百シェケル}}で、馬は{{units:約1.7キログラム|百五十シェケル}}で輸入された。同じように、王の商人たちの手を通して、それらはヘト人のすべての王とアラムの王たちに輸出された。
ja.R: エジプトから来る戦車は一台が銀{{units:約7キログラム|六百シェケル}}、馬は一頭が{{units:約1.7キログラム|百五十シェケル}}でした。王の商人たちは、ヘト人のすべての王たちやアラムの王たちにも、馬や戦車を売りました。

uk.L: І піднімали й вивозили з Єгипту колісницю за шістсот [шеклів] срібла, а коня за сто пʼятдесят; і так для всіх царів хетеїв і царів Араму їхньою рукою вивозили [їх].
uk.B: Колісницю привозили з Єгипту за {{units:близько 7 кілограмів|шістсот шеклів}} срібла, а коня за {{units:близько 1,7 кілограма|сто пʼятдесят шеклів}}. Так само через царських купців їх продавали всім царям хетеїв і царям Араму.
uk.R: Колісниця з Єгипту коштувала {{units:близько 7 кілограмів|шістсот шеклів}} срібла, а кінь — {{units:близько 1,7 кілограма|сто пʼятдесят шеклів}}. Царські купці також продавали коней і колісниці всім царям хетеїв і Араму.

decisions.choice: the prices of chariots and horses: 1 Kings 10:29
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 10:29 says "a chariot came up and went out from Egypt"; Chronicles says "they brought up and brought out", with the traders as subject. The prices and the trade with the north are the same.

decisions.choice: 600 of silver, 150: prices in shekels
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives the numbers without the unit; the shekel is understood. A chariot cost four times as much as a horse.

decisions.choice: by their hand they exported: the king's traders sold them on
decisions.reason: "Their hand" refers to the king's traders of verse 16. Solomon's merchants acted as middlemen, selling horses and chariots to the kingdoms to the north.

decisions.choice: the kings of the Hittites and of Aram: the kingdoms of Syria
decisions.reason: The Hittites here are the small kingdoms of northern Syria that kept the Hittite name after the old Hittite empire fell. Aram is the land of the Arameans, north and east of Israel.

decisions.choice: 600 [shekels of] silver (Literal); about 15 pounds and about 3 3/4 pounds (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal supplies "shekels" in brackets. Balanced and Readable give the weights in modern measure, with the shekels as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "unos 7 kilos" and "1,7 kilos" (metric); "seiscientos siclos", "ciento cincuenta siclos" (original)

records.literal_gloss: And said Solomon to build [a] house for [the] name of Yahweh and [a] house for his kingdom.

en.L: And Solomon said [he would] build a house for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and a house for his kingdom.
en.B: Solomon decided to build a house for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and a palace for his own reign.
en.R: Solomon decided to build a temple where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} would be worshiped, and a palace for himself as king.

es.L: Y dijo Salomón [que] edificaría una casa al nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y una casa para su reino.
es.B: Salomón decidió edificar una casa para el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y un palacio para su reinado.
es.R: Salomón decidió construir un templo donde se adoraría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y un palacio para él como rey.

fr.L: Et Salomon dit [qu’il allait] bâtir une maison pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et une maison pour son royaume.
fr.B: Salomon décida de bâtir une maison pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et un palais pour son règne.
fr.R: Salomon a décidé de construire un temple où l’on adorerait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et un palais royal pour lui-même.

sw.L: Sulemani akasema [kwamba atajenga] nyumba kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na nyumba kwa ajili ya ufalme wake.
sw.B: Sulemani aliamua kujenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na ikulu kwa ajili ya utawala wake.
sw.R: Sulemani aliamua kujenga hekalu ambamo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} angeabudiwa, na ikulu yake mwenyewe kama mfalme.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn truyền [lệnh] xây một nhà cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và một nhà cho vương quyền mình.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn quyết định xây một nhà cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và một cung điện cho vương triều mình.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn quyết định xây một đền thờ làm nơi thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và một cung điện cho chính mình là vua.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위한 집과 자기 나라를 위한 집을 짓겠다고 말했다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위하여 집을 짓고, 자기 왕권을 위하여 궁전을 짓기로 했다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 예배할 성전을 짓고, 왕으로서 자기가 살 왕궁도 짓기로 했다.

pt.L: E Salomão disse [que ia] construir uma casa para o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e uma casa para o seu reino.
pt.B: Salomão decidiu construir uma casa para o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e um palácio para o seu próprio reinado.
pt.R: Salomão decidiu construir um templo onde {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fosse adorado, e um palácio para ele mesmo como rei.

am.L: ሰሎሞንም {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስም ቤትን፣ ለመንግሥቱም ቤትን ሊሠራ አሰበ።
am.B: ሰሎሞን {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስም ቤትን፣ ለራሱም ቤተ መንግሥት ለመሥራት ወሰነ።
am.R: ሰሎሞን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚመለክበትን ቤተ መቅደስና ለራሱም ቤተ መንግሥት ለመሥራት ወሰነ።

hi.L: और सुलैमान ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम के लिए एक भवन और अपने राज्य के लिए एक भवन बनाने की बात कही।
hi.B: सुलैमान ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम के लिए एक भवन, और अपने राज्य के लिए एक महल बनाने का निश्चय किया।
hi.R: सुलैमान ने एक ऐसा मन्दिर बनाने का निश्चय किया जहाँ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आराधना हो, और अपने लिए राजा के योग्य एक महल भी।

ru.L: И решил Соломон построить дом для имени {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и дом для своего царства.
ru.B: Соломон решил построить дом для имени {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и дворец для своего царствования.
ru.R: Соломон решил построить храм, где люди будут поклоняться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и дворец для себя как царя.

ja.L: そしてソロモンは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名のための家と、自分の王国のための家を建てることを言った。
ja.B: ソロモンは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名のための家と、自分の王権のための宮殿を建てることに決めた。
ja.R: ソロモンは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を礼拝するための神殿と、王として住む宮殿を建てることに決めました。

uk.L: І сказав Соломон збудувати дім для імені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} і дім для свого царства.
uk.B: Соломон вирішив збудувати дім для імені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} і палац для свого царювання.
uk.R: Соломон вирішив збудувати храм, де поклонятимуться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, і палац для себе як царя.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: in many Bibles this verse begins chapter 2
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. In the Hebrew text chapter 1 ends with this verse, and chapter 2 begins with Solomon counting out his workers. Many Bibles number this verse 2:1, and so number Hebrew 2:1-17 as 2:2-18. The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: said: decided, gave orders
decisions.reason: The verb is the common word for "say". Followed by "to build" it means that Solomon declared his intention and gave the word for it (compare 1 Chronicles 21:17; 1 Kings 5:19).

decisions.choice: a house for the name of Yahweh: the temple
decisions.reason: Yahweh had said that David's son would build a house for his name (1 Chronicles 17:12; 22:10). The name stands for Yahweh himself, present among his people and called on there (Deuteronomy 12:5, 11).

decisions.choice: a house for his kingdom: a royal palace
decisions.reason: "A house for his kingdom" means a palace for his reign as king. Its building is mentioned with the temple's in 7:11 and 8:1, and described in 1 Kings 7:1-12.

decisions.choice: house (Literal, Balanced), temple (Readable); house for his kingdom (Literal), palace for his own reign (Balanced), palace for himself as king (Readable)
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew word "house" is used for Yahweh's temple and for the king's palace. Balanced keeps "house" for Yahweh's and says "palace" for the king's; Readable says "temple" and explains "for the name of the LORD" (m3), as 1 Kings 3:2 does.

decisions.choice: said [he would] build
decisions.reason: Literal supplies words in brackets so that "said to build" reads as English.

decisions.choice: "casa" (L, B), "templo" (R); "una casa para su reino" (L), "un palacio para su reinado" (B), "un palacio para él como rey" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Kings terms note: the house of Yahweh is "casa" at Literal and Balanced and "templo" at Readable; the house for his kingdom is a royal palace.

decisions.choice: nyumba (Literal, Balanced), hekalu (Readable); ikulu for the king's house (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the Swahili Kings drafts: the LORD's house is "nyumba" at Literal and Balanced and "hekalu" at Readable; the king's house is "ikulu", the ordinary word for a ruler's palace.

decisions.choice: "nhà" (L, B), "đền thờ" (R) for Yahweh's house; "nhà" (L), "cung điện" (B, R) for the king's
decisions.reason: One Hebrew word "house" for both; the wording kept from 1 Kings 3:1 and the terms note.

decisions.choice: "집" (L, B), "성전" (R); "나라를 위한 집" (L), "궁전" (B), "왕궁" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings: 성전 where the English says "temple", 주의 집 elsewhere; 궁전 (B) and 왕궁 (R) for the palace.

decisions.choice: a casa (L, B), o templo (R); a casa do SENHOR (L, B)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as 1 Kings 5:19 and 6:2 in Portuguese: Literal keeps the Hebrew "casa"; Balanced keeps "a casa" in the full phrases ("a casa do SENHOR", "a casa de Deus", "uma casa para o nome") and says "o templo" where "the house" alone names the building; Readable says "o templo". The king's house is "um palácio" at Balanced and Readable. Readable's "um templo onde o SENHOR fosse adorado" is the wording of 1 Kings 5:19.

decisions.choice: "ሊሠራ አሰበ" (Literal), "ለመሥራት ወሰነ" (Balanced, Readable) for "said to build"; the house for his kingdom is "ለመንግሥቱ ቤት" (Literal), "ቤተ መንግሥት" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Amharic "አለ" cannot take an infinitive; "said" here is a purpose, as in 1 Kings 5:19, where "I am saying to build" is "ለመሥራት አስቤአለሁ".

decisions.choice: "भवन" (L, B) for the LORD's house; "मन्दिर" (R), where the English says "temple"; "भवन" (L), "महल" (B, R) for the king's
alternatives: "भवन" at every level for the LORD's house
decisions.reason: The house of the LORD is {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भवन, as the history terms note sets and as in 1 Kings; where the English says "temple", Balanced and Readable say मन्दिर, as 1 and 2 Kings, Ezra, the Psalms and the Prophets do in this translation; the king's house is महल where the English says "palace".

decisions.choice: "дом ГОСПОДА" (L, B), "храм" (R); "дом для своего царства" (L), "дворец" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording for the house of the LORD in the history books, as in 1 Kings 3:1: Literal and Balanced keep "дом", Readable says "храм"; the king's house is "дворец" from Balanced on.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名のための家" (L, B), "…を礼拝するための神殿" (R); "自分の王国のための家" (L), "宮殿" (B, R).
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 5:19 and the 1KI temple vocabulary.
